operations.create: Create one task-scoped STATE.json through current_admission.build_initial_state.
operations.read: Read the task STATE.json and its exact referenced artifacts; observe_article returns the validated stage and next action.
operations.update: Change requirements through current_admission.apply_task_requirement_change; preserve append-only history and invalidate dependent evidence.
operations.delete: Do not erase historical receipts or accepted evidence. Retire requirements/methods through lifecycle operations; delete only disposable unreferenced temporary artifacts.
operations.delivery: Store actual DOCX, render receipts and verified page evidence under the same article delivery workspace.
operations.source_create: BLOCKED until the GitHub repository is PRIVATE and the hosted provider is live; upload an immutable original to the private Drive folder, read it back, then atomically admit GitHub source metadata and an effect receipt.
operations.source_read: Resolve exact source_id/version_id through GitHub metadata; read the exact Drive file_id/revision_id and verify the stored-payload SHA-256, retained normalized-text SHA-256, and provenance.
operations.source_update: Upload a new Drive file for the new version; never overwrite old bytes. After exact readback, CAS-update GitHub source metadata and append a signed effect receipt.
operations.source_delete: RETIRE in GitHub by default; preserve Drive originals and existing article bindings. Hard delete is forbidden for referenced sources and requires a separate approved history/backup purge for legal erasure.
operations.source_list_search: Search GitHub source metadata and return exact version-pinned references; Drive folder listing is only raw-object discovery, not the business registry.

external_inputs.chat: Source of user intent and explicit approval; never a shadow article-state store.
external_inputs.research_sources: External URLs and uploaded files become durable evidence only after the exact policy-permitted Drive payload is stored/read back (original bytes only when RAW_PRESERVED; otherwise permitted excerpt/metadata) and the GitHub source record binds the exact Drive file ID, revision, stored-payload digest, and retained-text digest.
external_inputs.google_drive_source_store: Private raw-source object store at the declared folder ID; stores immutable original files and large raw materials, not article state.
external_inputs.github_provider: Canonical authority for article state, source identity/lifecycle metadata, task bindings, methods, and exact CAS/readback; writes blocked until repository privacy and live Provider Action are verified.
external_inputs.notion: Reusable knowledge and evidence-link notes only; not the raw-source file store or Financial task-state authority.
external_inputs.temporary_files: Ephemeral work products only; never canonical state or a substitute source library.
